description: 30 labeled entity clarity examples for C5 eval. Each example is the first 100 words of a homepage. Labels: entityMentioned, categoryMentioned, targetAudienceMentioned.

examples.text: Acme CRM helps sales teams close more deals, faster. Built for B2B companies with 10 to 500 employees, Acme CRM gives your team a single place to track leads, manage pipelines, and forecast revenue. Join 3,000 sales teams that trust Acme CRM to grow their business.

Streamline is the project management tool for modern engineering teams. Plan sprints, track issues, and ship features without the overhead. Trusted by over 10,000 developers at fast-moving startups and scale-ups.
DataVault transforms raw data into business insights. Connect all your data sources in minutes and get dashboards your whole team can use. No SQL required.
Accept payments online in 135 currencies. Fast setup, low fees, and developer-friendly APIs. FlowPay powers millions of transactions for businesses of all sizes worldwide.

Helpy is the all-in-one customer support platform for growing SaaS companies. Manage tickets, live chat, and self-service knowledge base from a single dashboard. Reduce support volume by 40% with smart automation.
Send beautiful emails that actually convert. NovaSend combines drag-and-drop design with powerful automation and deep analytics. Used by 25,000 marketers in 80 countries.
Welcome to PulseDash. Bringing clarity to your business data since 2018. Our mission is to make analytics accessible for everyone.
TeamSync makes remote teams more productive. Real-time collaboration, async updates, and meeting summaries in one place. Perfect for distributed teams across time zones.
Automate your lead generation with AI. Our platform captures, qualifies, and routes leads 24/7 so your sales team can focus on closing. Join 2,500 B2B companies using us.
Create stunning charts and dashboards without writing code. ChartMind connects to any data source and generates publication-ready visualizations in seconds. Built for analysts and data teams.
Simplify your people operations. Onboarding, payroll, performance reviews, and time tracking — all automated and compliant. Scale from 10 to 10,000 employees without adding HR headcount.
Pricify helps SaaS founders find the right price. A/B test your pricing page, analyze willingness-to-pay data, and simulate revenue impact before you change anything.
We believe paperwork should be the last thing slowing you down. ClearSign lets you send, sign, and manage documents from anywhere. Legally binding in 190 countries.
Reportly is the reporting tool agencies and in-house marketing teams rely on to prove ROI. Connect 100+ data sources, build white-label dashboards, and schedule automated reports.
OpsFlow automates your business workflows without code. Connect apps, set triggers, and build multi-step automations in minutes. Replace manual processes for your operations team.
Take control of company spending. SpendSense gives finance teams real-time visibility into every purchase, streamlines approval workflows, and integrates with your ERP.
The home page of Docuify. Log in to access your documents. New to Docuify? Sign up free.
SecureVPN protects your privacy online. One click connects you to 3,200 servers in 65 countries. Unblock content, hide your IP, and encrypt your traffic. For individuals and businesses.
Re-engage your users with personalized push notifications. Notifio delivers real-time messages on web, iOS, and Android. Built for product teams who want to increase retention.
Stop wasting time in unproductive meetings. MeetingPro provides agendas, AI summaries, and action item tracking for every meeting. Used by executive teams at Fortune 500 companies.
Monitor what people are saying about your brand, competitors, and industry. Track mentions across social media, news, forums, and blogs in real time.
CodeReview makes code reviews faster and more effective for engineering teams. Automate checks, enforce standards, and ship better software with fewer bugs.
TaxEase simplifies tax filing for freelancers and small business owners. Import your transactions, categorize expenses, and generate accurate tax reports in minutes.
Create engaging surveys in minutes. SurveySpark offers 100+ templates, logic branching, and real-time response dashboards. Perfect for customer research and employee feedback.
CloudStore gives you secure, unlimited file storage. Access your files from anywhere, share with your team, and never worry about losing data again.
GrantWriter uses AI to help nonprofits and researchers write compelling grant applications. Find matching grants, draft proposals, and track submissions from one platform.
Get paid faster. Create professional invoices, accept online payments, and track what you're owed — all in under a minute.
AppTrack monitors the performance of your web and mobile applications in real time. Detect errors, slowdowns, and crashes before your users report them. Trusted by 500 engineering teams.
FeedbackLoop helps product teams collect, organize, and act on customer feedback at scale. Turn user insights into product decisions. Integrates with Jira, Linear, and Notion.
Booking meetings should be effortless. ScheduleAI eliminates back-and-forth emails by letting anyone book time directly on your calendar based on your real availability.
